stats.name: MP regen
stats.note: MP restored every 4 ticks, through the status it brings.

stats.name: Defense
stats.note: A hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + 0.25 × Defense): nearly linear against big hits, never a blank. A status's own damage never meets it.

stats.name: Aggro
stats.note: Centred on 100 (a word n is 70 + 10n, a gear or formation step 10), never below 1. Foes pick party members by draw from ruleset.partyDraw: an ordinary unit draws 100, and every 25 Aggro doubles it (halves it below 100), from Aggro 25 (12.5) to 200 (1,600). The party picks among foes by ruleset.draw's curve: none draws more than 300 or less than 33.

classes.name: Knight
classes.text: Protector. Starts every fight behind its own Shield, Guards whoever is lowest, calls every foe onto itself while an ally regains its mana, and bashes a foe with the weight of its own body.

classes.name: Cleric

classes.name: Ranger
classes.text: The marksman. Looses barbed, cold and rending arrows at whatever stands in front, while its plain arrows fly past any guard, crit for a living and open the wounds.

passive.name: Hunter's eye

classes.text: Thorns tank. Draws every foe onto its thorns, where each attacker is left bleeding for the party's blows, regrows whoever is lowest, and lashes out with the thorns themselves.

passive.name: Briar
passive.text: Each time its Thorns damage a foe, that foe gets a few Bleed; stacks scale from Defense.

classes.name: Hoplite
classes.text: The bruiser. Slow double swings, a thrust that opens one foe up, a shove with the whole shield that sunders every foe, and an Aegis on the ally about to take the killing blow. Very tanky and hits hard; nothing it does draws fire.

passive.name: Phalanx
passive.text: Its basic attacks come half as often and deal double damage.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.text: The judge: helper of the righteous, killer of the wicked. Its hits land half again as hard on any foe that holds a buff or a debuff; it condemns one foe and the whole party strikes it; it lifts curses and heals; and it brings down a slow, heavy, burning Smite.

passive.name: Judgement
passive.text: Its hits deal half again as much damage to foes with a buff or a debuff.

classes.name: Valkyrie
classes.text: The shieldmaiden: a quick, survivable damage dealer, not a tank. Her spear builds her Shield as it strikes, three quick hits reach past any guard and shock what they hit, a heavy blow from above cashes the Shock in, and she chooses the slain: one ability mends the lowest ally or raises a fallen one.

passive.name: Shieldmaiden
passive.text: Each hit it lands gives it a Shield of a share of the damage dealt.

classes.name: Bard
classes.text: Party tempo. A caster at the back whose every note mends an ally a little and gives another mana, with a ballad that steadies the party, an allegro that quickens it, and an encore that makes an ally's next spell sound twice.

passive.name: Refrain
passive.text: Each of its basic attacks that lands heals a random ally and gives a random ally MP, each a share of the damage dealt.

classes.name: Hexer
classes.text: The spellblade. A blade that carries curses: its swing chills, its curses deepen every affliction a foe already holds, it weakens and sunders the most dangerous one, and it silences a foe mid-cast and strips its buffs.

passive.name: Cold hex
passive.text: Its basic attacks add a few Chill, whatever weapon it carries; stacks scale from Attack.

classes.name: Monk
classes.text: Sunders with a blur of blows. Every blow leaves the foe a little more open, Flow keeps it fast, burning fists pile onto the hottest foe, and a pressure point drops the most dangerous one for a moment.

passive.name: Iron palm
passive.text: Its basic attacks, and the second strike of its Double strike, add a few Sunder; stacks scale from Attack.

classes.name: Assassin

classes.name: Vampire
classes.text: Drains to outlast. Feeds on everything it hits: the harder it hits, the more it heals, its prey is left weakened, and it bleeds its own life into an ally's wounds and mana.

passive.name: Bloodlust

classes.name: Pyromancer
